messages:
Ops Bot: announce: new Dedicated pool live in SYD3: 'tungsten-syd3'. Initial capacity: 16 instances. Flavor: Tungsten-E (high-memory, NVCache tuned). Tags: #dedicated #tungsten #syd3 :sparkles:
Priya S: quick Q for teams: what's the primary target workload?
Diego M: Tungsten is optimized for multi-document RAG and long-context fine-tuning serving. NVCache reduces cold-starts for large KV. Expect ~20% lower cost/req for heavy-RAG compared to our a100 baseline.
EngInfra: reservation model: 60% burst / 40% reserved at launch. You can reserve via Console or CLI. CLI example:
```
redwood reserve --pool tungsten-syd3 --count 3 --duration 30d --commit monthly --tags team=search
```
Priya S: billing impact?
Finance Bot: new SKU 'dedicated.tungsten' effective now. Meter: instance-minute. Intro promo: first 45 days 3% rebate for teams that tag reservations with `team=` and migrate production traffic.
Diego M: compatibility note: supports 8-bit and 4-bit quant paths; for models requiring >12GB KV use model_profile="tungsten-xkv". No runtime ABI changes expected.
EngInfra: routing/fallback: default fallback is tungsten-syd3-compat -> syd1-standard -> global-h100. Toggle strict routing in Console to prevent automatic failover.
Priya S: maintenance/preemption?
EngInfra: reserved commits are non-preemptible. Burst instances may be reclaimed during planned maintenance; maintenance windows will be posted to #infra-maintenance.
Priya S: who to ping on perf regressions?
Diego M: @EngInfra and @Infra Oncall. Include p95 latency, error rate, and a short repro or request ids.
Ops Bot: rollout plan: day 0 soft-open (this), day 5 expand to 32 instances if health signals are green, day 14 open annual commit options. Docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/tungsten-syd3 (internal).
Finance Bot: operational tip: include `team=` tag on reservations so cost shows correctly in Console reports.
Priya S: thanks everyone, will run canary tonight and report metrics here. :thumbsup:
Diego M: thanks team — escalate on >7% error or >25% latency regression.
